contract: Airlock Mirror: live operator view of a cross-company agent boundary. Job: watch crossings happen and see each one signed and countersigned. Primary surfaces: hero (FluidGlass 3D lens over AIRLOCK, live counters, latest crossing on glass), three-locks explainer, control room (three chambers with pressure doors), ledger chain. Palette: graphite ground, Acme amber, PayCo teal, steel shared, red only for breach/decline. Motion: GSAP door + capsule per approved crossing, ScrollTrigger reveals, Lenis synced to GSAP ticker; reduced motion disables Lenis and travel.

accessibility.evidence: Semantic sections with aria-labelledby on every chamber, the ledger and the locks; h1 present (visually hidden) with the wordmark as an img with aria-label; decorative doors and FluidGlass canvas aria-hidden; status and alerts use role=status/role=alert; visible focus ring via :focus-visible; reduced motion verified in the browser: Lenis inactive, chambers opacity 1 immediately, counters at final values.

responsive.evidence: 1440x900: three chambers side by side with doors, fixed-height scrolling panels, no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth <= innerWidth). 390x844: hero lens scales to 120px, copy and counters wrap, scroll cue hidden to avoid overlap, chambers stack, no horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: 'Connecting to the ledgers…' notice renders until the first server-sent event arrives.

empty.evidence: With no crossings the control room shows 'No crossings yet' and the exact command to start the scenario.

error.evidence: If the API never answers, 'Mirror is offline' explains how to start it and offers a Retry button; a dropped connection keeps the last state with a 'Reconnecting' pill (EventSource retries).

partial.evidence: If one company's ledger is missing, a banner names it and that seal reads 'ledger not on this machine'; the rest renders.

success.evidence: Run 3 replay renders 13 crossings, 3 withheld, 53 verified signatures, typed query and answer as chips, every crossing 'ML-DSA-65 ✓ · countersigned ✓'.

permission.reason: Local operator view that reads ledger files on the same machine; there is no account or access level in the Mirror itself (approval rights live in Telegram, enforced by the envoy).

renderedEvidence.observation: Logo and live status at top; FluidGlass lens idles over AIRLOCK with refraction and chromatic dispersion; tagline, counters (13/3/53/11) and latest-crossing glass card do not overlap.
Three chambers with striped pressure doors; typed query/answer render as wrapped chips; every shared crossing shows ML-DSA-65 and countersigned ticks.
Three SpotlightCards with live figures 3 withheld, 13 approved, 13/13 countersigned.
Lens scaled over AIRLOCK, copy wraps, counters in two columns, no overlap, no horizontal scroll.
